meta.populationDefinition: Estimated Korean population at each hour; not unique visitors
meta.marketDefinition: Quarterly source footfall population indicator; not daily unique visitors
meta.populationAggregation: Group administrative dong codes by first five digits and hour. Any selected masked cell makes the entire gu-hour aggregate null. All/all uses the source total column; other combinations sum selected original columns.
meta.marketScope: All 74 Jongno-gu markets present in source period 2026Q2, joined to actual geometry; population series 2025Q1-2026Q2 and sales 2025Q1-Q4. This is not a Seoul-wide market inventory.
meta.marketMarginals: Sex, age, time, weekday are separate marginal distributions; do not multiply or cross-filter. Keep source rounding differences.
meta.geometry: Gu shapes and Jongno-gu outline plus actual 74 market boundaries and 22 Gangnam dong boundaries, projected with d3-geo. Market paths use Jongno focus projection; gu and dong paths share Seoul projection. Boundary vintage does not imply matching statistical vintage.
meta.salesDefinition: Quarterly estimated sales in KRW, summed over source-provided industries; source totals preserved; absent industry/quarter is null, not zero.

dongScope.unsupportedDatePolicy: 20261030 has no dong series in this prototype; offer gu overview or supported date instead of silently changing scope.
